source: Manual snapshot of October 19, 2026 (BLS, BEA, FOMC and FRED figures gathered by hand)
seedNote: This is the hand-gathered reading from October 19, 2026. The daily FRED update replaces it, and adds the full history from 1990, on its first run.

indicators.name: Unemployment rate
indicators.rule: Up 0.5 pt or more from its 12-month low: Contraction. Up 0.2 pt: Late. Falling from 5% or above: Early. Otherwise Mid.

indicators.name: Payroll growth, 3-month average
indicators.rule: Below 0: Contraction. Below +75k a month: Late. Below +250k: Mid. Otherwise Early.

indicators.name: Initial jobless claims, 4-week average
indicators.rule: 30% or more above its 52-week low: Contraction. 15% above: Late. Otherwise Mid.

indicators.name: Chicago Fed National Activity Index, 3-month average
indicators.rule: At or below -0.70: Contraction. Below -0.35: Late. Above +0.20 within a year of a reading at or below -0.70: Early. Otherwise Mid.

indicators.name: CPI inflation, year over year
indicators.rule: 3% or above and higher than 3 months earlier: Late. 2.5% or below and falling: Early. Otherwise Mid.

indicators.name: Fed funds target, upper bound
indicators.rule: Higher than 3 months earlier: Late. Lower: Early. Unchanged: Mid.

indicators.name: Yield curve, 10-year minus 3-month
indicators.rule: Inverted: Late. Positive but inverted at some point in the past 6 months: Contraction. Above +150 bp: Early. Otherwise Mid.

indicators.name: Real GDP growth, annualized
indicators.rule: Below 0: Contraction. Below 1%: Late. Below 3%: Mid. Otherwise Early.

indicators.name: 10-year real yield (TIPS)
indicators.rule: 2.5% or above: Late. 0.5% or below: Early. Otherwise Mid.

indicators.name: Brent crude, change over 12 months
indicators.rule: Up 40% or more: Late. Down 30% or more: Contraction. Otherwise Mid.

indicators.name: Corporate profits after tax, year over year
indicators.rule: Below 0: Contraction. Below 5%: Late. Otherwise Mid.
